article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 16 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Carter Family Border Radio, Edward R. Murrow, Orson Welles, and Moon Over Morocco
article-meta.kwd-group: The Carter Family, Border Radio, XERA, Edward R Murrow, Buchenwald, Orson Welles, War Bonds, Willie Mays, Moon Over Morocco, Jack Flanders, Tales of Pacific Powerland, Yank Bandstand, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 80 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 80 recovers and dates 16 historical broadcasts across country music foundations, broadcast journalism monuments, wartime rallies, binaural audio adventures, sports history, and northwestern regional folklore: 3 rare 1939 high-power Mexican border radio transcriptions from ***The Carter Family On Border Radio*** (A.P., Sara, and Maybelle Carter on XERA), Edward R. Murrow's devastating April 15, 1945 CBS report on the liberation of Buchenwald and his *I Can Hear It Now* series, Orson Welles delivering an urgent 1943 national war bond address, the Allied Military Government's May 4, 1945 resumption of Radio Hamburg, 3 chapters of Meatball Fulton's surreal stereo masterpiece ***Moon Over Morocco*** (ZBS, 1974), 3 Pacific Northwest historical legends narrated by Nelson Olmsted on ***Tales of Pacific Powerland*** (1953), Willie Mays' immortal 1954 catch on ***Greatest Sports Thrills***, newsreel voice Ed Herlihy on ***Recollections at 30***, and swing music on AFRS ***Yank Bandstand***.
